limiterDetail: Main limiter: rain on the west and central grounds until ~5 PM, then evening currents in the east. Wind is not a problem (0.8–6 kt now, gusts ≤12). Showers are ~1.1 mm/h at Coron, Culion and Galoc around 3–5 PM, then dry from ~6 PM. Currents are favorable everywhere now (≤0.3 kt) but build to 1.0–1.3 kt at Decabaitot, Tara, Turda and Alava around 6–10 PM.

changed.title: ⚠️ What changed since this morning
items: Wed 14 upgraded from MARGINAL to GOOD. ECMWF now has Wednesday drier (~6.7 mm, was ~9.6) with wind 9.7 kt, gusts 16, still in the Good class. Fishermen activity Wednesday goes back to HIGH.
Supply outlook improved for the next 48h. Tomorrow (Wed) is now ABOVE NORMAL, and Wednesday's catch should cushion Thursday. Shortage risk now starts Thu instead of today (window Thu → Mon 19).

Fri 16 is now the worst day (10 kt, gusts 18, ~14.5 mm), taking over from Thu 15 (now 9.3 kt, gusts 18, ~12.9 mm). Thu 15 is still the turning point to MARGINAL. Today's grounds slipped to 8 GOOD / 5 MARGINAL (morning: 11 / 2) on afternoon showers in the west.
